name: v8-r10-ic-shrink
description: Cell R-10 (Ruling E-38 slot 49: runs only if R-6 is accepted, else registered for v9): composition ic-shrink-v1 (lane COMB2, task-R-10-report.md; every constant fixed blind before any read). Inside each theme, member weights proportional to a James-Stein shrunk IC estimate: ic_k = the fitter's admission train_mean (the parent fit window; no new window, no new read), shrunk_k = .5 x theme mean + .5 x ic_k (intensity .5 toward the theme's equal weight), floored at 0, a theme with no positive value at equal shares; theme share 1/T and member cap 1/(2T) as in ew-theme-std-v1; the IC runner's per-date standardisation unchanged (theme_standardise rule ic-shrink-v1, its weights verified against the recorded ICs to 1e-12). The change: fit --composition ic-shrink-v1, mapped from the parent's ew-theme-std-v1 only (an ew-theme-v1 parent has no standardisation to keep; an ew-theme-std-aim-v1 parent's gains would be dropped: root rules before any run). Inherits Ruling E-28's 3,072 MiB w pass from R-1. Downstream outputs renamed (fit, card, w, nav, monitor); the u pass is the parent's. Identity (code, before the cell): gtest CompositionV8.IcShrinkRunsTheStandardisationUnchangedAndRecordsItsRule and the fitter's flag-absent test. Acceptance: paired S2 net dSR > 0 against the parent AND mechanics AND planned turnover per unit gross not higher than the parent's (the composition-cell criterion of R-1, plan 12.1).
